species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 67°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 6–28 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
North wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the south shore: try the wind-blown banks.

species.name: Spotted bass
why: Water 67°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 4–22 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
North wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the south shore: try the wind-blown banks.

why: Water 67°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
